text.aria-label: Title text 'Figure 3: Net summer power drawn by time of day, on clear and overcast days, at six Primary substations'
text.tspan: Figure 3: Net summer power drawn by time of day, on clear and overcast

text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Mean half-hourly power drawn from the electricity network (MW), after embedded solar has supplied part of the local demand, April to September. Clear day: daily surface sunlight at least 0.8 times its clear-sky value, from CAMS (the Copernicus Atmosphere Monitoring Service). Overcast day: at most 0.3 times. Dashed line: the first season-year of each Primary substation's record. Solid line: 2025/26. On clear days the midday dip is deeper, partly because embedded solar supplies local demand. Each panel has its own y axis.'
